title: List coloring and Gallai trees
author: Zdenek Dvorak
used_claims: Lemma 7: a connected uncolorable degree assignment is tight at every vertex; strict-list greedy ordering proves the contrapositive.
Theorem 10: connected noncolorability of a degree assignment is equivalent to Gallai-tree structure and a blockwise-uniform assignment.
Incident block palettes at a shared cut vertex are disjoint; each vertex list is their union.
